metadata.name: POC flapping spans (single episode active/recovering)
metadata.description: recovering->inactive gated by AND(recovering_count 5, recovering_timeframe 10m). A 3m recover phase yields only ~3 recovering evals (< 5) inside the 10m timeframe, so the gate never fires: the episode stays alive and re-breaches back to active. ONE episode oscillates active/recovering/active/recovering, each run keyed by its own episode.status_started_at. This is the primary lossless-flapping case for PR #275654.

breach.query: FROM kbn-data-forge-fake_hosts.fake_hosts-* | WHERE event.dataset == "system.cpu" | STATS avg_cpu = AVG(system.cpu.user.pct) BY host.name | WHERE avg_cpu > 80
